name: How to Prevent Prompt Injection: 13 Attacks, Tested
title: How to Prevent Prompt Injection: 13 Attacks, Tested
summary: If your app has a model read documents, emails or web pages, anyone who writes in them can try to give it instructions. We ran 25 attacks against four current models with each defense on and off. Labels cut attack emails, but only checking every tool call with Armor stopped all of them.
